notes: All standard TUS branch IDs now use custom branch-specific SVG icons instead of generic icon-library choices.
Branch transition overlay now renders a reusable animated visual with per-branch particle/effect tokens.
Transition copy now supports a concise branch-specific tagline.
Reduced-motion support keeps the experience stable with shortened/non-looped animations.
